text:
priya: Quick check-in: we need a crisp pilot gate definition for the Tuning Advisor (batching + prefix cache + quant suggestions + eval-sentry). Customers want to know what we ship in alpha vs what stays for GA.
leo: Proposal: ALPHA = read-only recommendations in Console + eval-sentry webhook + route-level opt-out flag. GA = automated per-route rollouts + in-console "apply" button + exportable rule sets.
marta: We should call out data retention explicitly. Some customers need 180d for audit. Can we offer configurable retention per-account?
rachel: SRE note: batching can increase p95; define a max allowed uplift (e.g., +10% p95) when advisor recommendations are applied auto. For alpha we only surface warnings, not auto-apply.
priya: Good. For alpha: manual apply only. Also need a clear rollback CLI and a one-click revert in Console.
leo: Engineering needs: trace sampler (1% sample or up to 10k events/day), cache simulator, and a quant-sim that estimates quality delta for int8/fp16. We'll ship quant-sim results with confidence scores.
marta: Acceptance criteria draft for alpha:
```
- Console shows per-route recommendations for batching/caching/quant with rationale
- Eval-sentry issues alerts to webhook with trace links (debounced)
- Route-level flag: "tuning_advisor_opt_out" honored for manual rollouts
- Telemetry: batch_size_avg, cache_hit_rate, quant_confidence exposed in metrics
```

sam: Debounce policy suggestion: fire alert after 3 failing evals within 48h and when rolling average of metric deviates > 2 sigma. Include human-readable reason in payload.
rachel: Ops runbook must include circuit-breaker thresholds: if p95 increases by >15% or error_rate > 1% post-change, auto-disable the recommendation and page on-call.
leo: Risk: mis-suggested quant causing hallucination spikes. Mitigation: recommend A/B run with eval shard and require owner ack before apply. Also provide an "apply in dry-run" mode that only records telemetry.
marta: Perf test plan: three scenarios (chat_short, doc_summarization_long, streaming_transcript). For each run, measure baseline and with fp16/int8 sim; capture p50,p95,p99 and ROE (regression on evals).
priya: Pilot customer asks: BetaCorp wants per-route advice + a way to pin certain routes to "no-quant". We'll support pin via route metadata key `no_quant=true` in alpha.
sam: Docs: include rollback examples and how to interpret quant_confidence. Example CLI to revert route changes:
```
# force-disable tuning advisor on route
redwood routes patch my-route --metadata '{"no_quant":true}'
```
rachel: Monitoring: add an Ops dashboard tile for "advisor-impact" showing before/after p95 and cache_hit_rate; engineer should be able to click to see traces.
leo: Timeline: prototype traces sampler (4 days), console list UI (7 days), eval-sentry webhook + debounce (5 days), pilot docs (3 days). Alpha with 3 customers for 14 days, then gated beta.
marta: Sign-off criteria for alpha -> beta: at least 2/3 customers show cache_hit_rate >= 20% on recommended routes OR clear mitigation plan if lower; no high-severity quality regressions (any customer-evaluated regression > 10% must have mitigation).
priya: Action items: leo (sampler + quant-sim) due in 4d, marta (docs + runbook) due in 5d, rachel (SLO thresholds + dashboard) due in 6d, sam (confirm pilot customers) due in 2d. I'll coordinate stakeholder sign-off.
sam: I'll onboard DataCo and BetaCorp; can add Acme as third if they opt in. Need support rota.
priya: One more: make alert payload include a hashed prompt id (for privacy) + link to console trace viewer. Keep raw prompts in customer-controlled retention.
marta: Agree. Also surface a "why" field: short sentence why we recommended X.
leo: Noted. We'll include confidence and delta_estimate fields in recs API.
priya: OK meeting adjourned. Reconvene in 48 hrs for status. :thumbsup:
devops-bot: deploy notice: branch tuning-advisor/alpha -> staged; e2e tests queued :gear:
